exclusions.range_contracts: exclude until tie and full-precision settlement semantics are independently verified
exclusions.preliminary_or_revised_settlement_values: exclude unless matching the first official non-preliminary source used by contract resolution

primary_endpoint: one-sided 95% cluster-bootstrap lower confidence bound of fee- and depth-adjusted entry-to-settlement net dollars per contract
promotion_rule: No promotion from V11 research. A later separate review may be requested only if the pre-registered lower confidence bound is greater than zero, calibration error is at most 0.02, and all timing/settlement/fee evidence is complete.
retirement_rule: Retire v1.0.0 after the registered sample if the lower confidence bound is less than or equal to zero under every pre-registered latency and fee sensitivity.
more_data_rule: Collect more data only if the registered sample-size target has not been reached or the confidence interval contains zero; do not introduce unregistered feature variants.
falsifier: A negative lower confidence bound under the pre-registered station-mapped, entry-to-settlement calculation falsifies the v1.0.0 hypothesis.
